desc: convert an AVS X image to a Netpbm image
r: avstopam - convert an AVS X image to a Netpbm image

This program is part of Netpbm(1).

avstopam reads a Stardent AVS X image as input and produces a Netpbm image as output.

avsfile is the input file, which defaults to Standard Input. Output is always on Standard Output.

There are no command line options defined specifically for avstopam, but it recognizes the options common to all programs based on libnetpbm (See
Common Options .)
